subject: [PATCH nfs-utils v3 03/11] mountd: answer requests the kernel rejects on the netlink downcall

2026-09-14.patch_summary: This patch modifies the mountd service to handle rejected requests from the kernel due to failed filehandle construction or other issues. When a request is rejected, it resubmits each entry individually and answers negative for any entries that are still refused by the kernel. This approach prevents pending requests from piling up and allows clients to recover from failures more efficiently.
